_comment: Boars (2026-11-14, d0haste). The GREEDY twin of boars_flinthoof_cast_then_haste.json: the same frame
(Stomping Ground + Forest + a non-sick Ignoble Hierarch, Flinthoof in hand, opponent at 4; cast
Flinthoof {1}{G} as a 3/3, {R} haste, attack alone with exalted = 4) played by the DEPTH-0 RUNNER,
whose policy is TurnSolver::Solve -- the same policy every playout turn beyond the search horizon
uses. Solve had no route to a just-cast Flinthoof's haste (CollectActions offers the activation only
for a creature already on the battlefield) and won T5. MTG_GREEDY_SELF_HASTE adds the rider
(AppendGreedySelfHasteRiders): cast + {R} reserved + activation applied, scored with its attack.
